title: A Black Tie Affair
notes: Blue won the black-tie gala menu challenge, led by Valentin's sea bass and Miles's meat dish, and Mya used her Punishment Pass to swap onto Blue's cruise reward. Ramsay moved Mike from Blue to Red, then sent Red's fish station, Haley and Sandra, out of service; Red lost. Haley, Sandra and Kylie faced elimination (Kylie's nomination is from Gold Derby only), and Haley went home.
